summary: Riot Platforms filed an 8-K reporting that on September 21, 2026 it voluntarily prepaid in full all outstanding principal under its Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated April 21, 2026 with Coinbase Credit, Inc. as lender and collateral agent. The facility provided a secured term loan of up to $200 million, collateralized by pledged bitcoin, USDC, and cash held at Coinbase Custody Trust Company. Because the prepayment occurred after the four-month anniversary of the original maturity date, the day-count fraction was zero and no early termination fee or penalty was incurred. Obligations were discharged, the facility and lender commitment terminated, and security interests were released.
